task:
Open Obsidian with the vault at /home/user/Documents/ThemeVault. Using the Settings dialog, configure the appearance:

Change the base theme to light mode (set theme to 'moonstone'), set the base font size to 18
, set the accent color to '#E11D48' (a rose color).

Then create a note called 'ThemeTest.md' in the vault root with body:

# Theme Test
This note verifies the theme was changed.
The editor should now show light mode with larger text.
#test #appearance

cli_feasibility.translation: 1) 使用 Python 或直接编辑 .obsidian/app.json 设置 theme='moonstone', baseFontSize=18, accentColor='#E11D48'; 2) 使用 cli-anything-obsidian vault create 创建 ThemeTest.md
cli_feasibility.reason: 任务描述包含'Using the Settings dialog'、'Go to Settings > Appearance'等GUI术语，但CLI agent可以直接修改配置文件.json并创建note
